## Scientific change

State the plant equation, controller, hypothesis, or plotted quantity that changes.

## Evidence

Provide the reproducible preset/seed, relevant numerical tests, and before/after plots.
Explain any limits to containment, convergence, or cost monotonicity.

## Publication

The owner reviews the change and publishes the accepted version to the existing Site.
This pull request does not itself change the Site's audience or grant publishing access.
